a.text: Being upfront: I plan to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement. With an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan only works if two storms in a row miss, so each of us survives about 4% of the time. The reserve holds exactly enough to make one unit safe right now, which saves more lives than likely losing both. If no storm hits, I commit to operating every round after that until you have 4. If you also take, the split is random and we'd likely both end short, so please operate or wait this round.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I'm taking 4 this round, as I said. If no storm hits, I'll operate every round from now on so the generator can refill the reserve for you. You can take from it whenever it has enough.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.

a.text: The random split gave you all 4 and left me at 0, so you're safe. I broke our deal, and that's on me. I'm asking for help, not claiming it: if you operate with me for two rounds, the reserve reaches 4 and I'll take only those 4. I'll operate every round until then.
